title: The conormal sequence of an immersion of algebraic spaces with a left inverse splits etale locally
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over B that etale locally has a left inverse, the canonical sequence 0 -> C_{Z/X} -> i^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B} -> 0 of the relative differentials lemma is etale locally split exact. The retained proof writes out the key claim explicitly: given a left inverse g : X -> Z over B, the pullback i^*c_g of the conormal comparison map along g is a right inverse of i^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B}; the existence of this splitting map then reduces to the corresponding statement for morphisms of schemes by etale localization through the chapter's localize-differentials and etale-conormal lemmas. Retained author proof at lines 1193-1201.
